docs.summary: Represents a logical input action (e.g., "Jump", "Move", "Fire"). Actions are independent of specific devices and can have multiple bindings.
The composite bindings for this action (read-only).
The name of this action.
The type of action (Value, Button, or PassThrough).
The expected value type for this action (typeof(float), typeof(Float2)).
The list of bindings for this action.
The current phase of this action.
Whether this action is currently enabled.

docs.summary: Reads the current value of this action.
Reads the current value as an object.
Checks if the action was pressed this frame (for button actions).
Checks if the action was released this frame (for button actions).

Whether the action performed this frame, for any action type. For a Value action with an interaction, such as a double tap Dash, this is the frame to act on, and ReadValue gives the value it performed with.
Checks if the action is currently pressed (for button actions).
